```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(jsonlite)
library(modelsummary)
library(sandwich)
```

```{r}
#Importing cleaned_canada
data <- read_csv('cleaned_canada.csv')
head(data)
```

```{r}
#start filtering and summarizing data
housing <- data|>
  filter(City == 'Vancouver')|>
  select(Latitude, Longitude, Price, Bedrooms, Bathrooms, `Property Type`, `Square Footage`, Garage, Pool, Garden)|>
  rename(Type = `Property Type`, Sqft = `Square Footage`)|>
  filter(Type == 'Condo' | Type == 'Townhome' | Type == 'Single Family')
glimpse(housing)
summary(housing)
```
```{r}
#importing public parks and arts
parks<-read_csv2('parks-polygon-representation.csv')|>
  select(`Park Name`, geo_point_2d)|>
  separate(col = geo_point_2d, into = c('Latitude', 'Longitude'), sep = ',', convert = TRUE, remove = TRUE)|>
  rename(park_name = `Park Name`)
art<-read_csv2('public-art.csv')|>
  rename(name = `Title of Work`)|>
  filter(!is.na(Geom))|>
  mutate(longitude = vapply(Geom, function(x) {
      jsonlite::fromJSON(x)$coordinates[1]
    }, numeric(1)),
    latitude = vapply(Geom, function(x) {
      jsonlite::fromJSON(x)$coordinates[2]
    }, numeric(1))
  )|>
  select(name, longitude, latitude)
head(art)
head(parks)
```
```{r}
#distance to parks
sf_use_s2(TRUE)
housing_sf <- st_as_sf(housing, coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)
parks_sf <- st_as_sf(parks, coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)
art_sf <- st_as_sf(art, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)
nearest_park <- st_nearest_feature(housing_sf, parks_sf)
nearest_art <- st_nearest_feature(housing_sf, art_sf)
distance_park <- st_distance(housing_sf, 
                        parks_sf[nearest_park, ], 
                        by_element = TRUE)
distance_art <- st_distance(housing_sf, 
                            art_sf[nearest_art, ],
                            by_element = TRUE)
housing$nearest_park <- parks_sf$park_name[nearest_park]
housing$distance_park <- as.numeric(units::set_units(distance_park, 'm'))
housing$nearest_art <- art_sf$name[nearest_art]
housing$distance_art <- as.numeric(units::set_units(distance_art, 'm'))
housing<-select(housing, Latitude, Longitude, Price, Bedrooms, Bathrooms, Type, Sqft, distance_park, distance_art)

head(housing)
```
```{r}
url <- paste0(
  "https://opendata.vancouver.ca/api/explore/v2.1/",
  "catalog/datasets/local-area-boundary/exports/geojson"
)
neighbourhoods <- st_read(url)
neighbourhoods <- st_transform(
  neighbourhoods, 
  st_crs(housing_sf)
)
housing_sf <- st_join(housing_sf, 
                      neighbourhoods %>% select(name), 
                      join = st_within, 
                      left = TRUE)
housing_sf <- housing_sf|>
  rename(neighbourhood = name)
housing$neighbourhood <- housing_sf$neighbourhood
housing<-filter(housing, !is.na(neighbourhood))
head(housing)
```
```{r}
housing_sf<-filter(housing_sf, !is.na(neighbourhood))
ggplot()+
  geom_sf(data = neighbourhoods, 
          fill = 'lightblue', 
          color = 'white')+
  geom_sf(data = housing_sf, 
          color = 'red', 
          size = 0.3, 
          alpha = 0.5)+
  labs(title = 'Housing Locations in Vancouver')+
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r}

datasummary(
  Price + Bedrooms + Bathrooms + Sqft +
  distance_park + distance_art ~
  N + Mean + SD + Min + Median + Max,
  data = housing,
  fmt = 2,
  title = "Panel A: Numerical Variables"
)

# Categorical variables
datasummary(
  Type + neighbourhood ~ N + Percent(),
  data = housing,
  fmt = 2,
  title = "Panel B: Property Types"
)
```

```{r}
plot1
```

```{r}
nbh_mean <- housing|>
  group_by(neighbourhood)|>
  summarize(mean = mean(Price),
            sd = sd(Price))
nbh_mean
type_mean <- housing|>
  group_by(Type)|>
  summarize(mean = mean(Price), 
            sd = sd(Price))
type_mean
```
```{r}
housing <- housing |>
  mutate(
    log_Price         = log(Price),
    log_Sqft          = log(Sqft),
    log_distance_park = log(distance_park),
    log_distance_art  = log(distance_art)
  )
vars_to_scale <- c("log_Price", "log_Sqft", "Bedrooms", "Bathrooms",
                   "log_distance_park", "log_distance_art")

housing_std <- housing |>
  mutate(across(all_of(vars_to_scale),
                ~ as.numeric(scale(.x)),
                .names = "{.col}_z"))
housing_std |>
  summarise(across(ends_with("_z"), list(mean = mean, sd = sd)))
head(housing_std)
```
```{r}
housing_std <- housing_std|>
  mutate(Type = factor(Type), neighbourhood = factor(neighbourhood))
housing_std$Type <- relevel(housing_std$Type, ref = "Townhome")
model1 <- lm(log_Price_z ~ log_Sqft_z, data = housing_std)
model2 <- lm(log_Price_z ~ log_Sqft_z + neighbourhood, data = housing_std)
model3 <- lm(log_Price_z ~ log_Sqft_z + Bathrooms_z + Bedrooms_z + Type, data = housing_std)
model4 <- lm(log_Price_z ~ (log_Sqft_z + Bathrooms_z + Bedrooms_z)*Type, data = housing_std)
model5 <- lm(log_Price_z ~ (log_Sqft_z + Bathrooms_z + Bedrooms_z)*Type +
               log_distance_park_z + log_distance_art_z, data = housing_std)
model6 <- lm(log_Price_z ~ (log_Sqft_z + Bathrooms_z + Bedrooms_z)*Type +
               log_distance_park_z + log_distance_art_z + neighbourhood, data = housing_std)

models <- list(
    "Model 1" = model1,
    "Model 2" = model2,
    "Model 3" = model3,
    "Model 4" = model4,
    "Model 5" = model5,
    "Model 6" = model6
)
additional_rows <- data.frame(
    term = c("Interaction Terms", "Neighbourhood FE"),
    "Model 1" = c("No", "No"),
    "Model 2" = c("No", "Yes"),
    "Model 3" = c("No", "No"),
    "Model 4" = c("Yes", "No"),
    "Model 5" = c("Yes", "No"),
    "Model 6" = c("Yes", "Yes"),
    check.names = FALSE
)
modelsummary(
    models,
    title = "Determinants of Housing Prices in Vancouver",
    estimate = "{estimate}{stars}",
    statistic = "({std.error})",
    stars = c("*" = 0.10, "**" = 0.05, "***" = 0.01),
    fmt = 4,
    vcov = "HC3",
    coef_omit = "^neighbourhood",
    coef_rename = c(
      "log_Sqft_z"          = "Log(Square Footage), std.",
      "Bathrooms_z"         = "Bathrooms, std.",
      "Bedrooms_z"          = "Bedrooms, std.",
      "log_distance_park_z" = "Log(Distance to Park), std.",
      "log_distance_art_z"  = "Log(Distance to Public Art), std.",
      "TypeCondo"           = "Condo",
      "TypeSingle Family"   = "Single Family"
    ),
    gof_map = c(
        "nobs",
        "r.squared",
        "adj.r.squared",
        "rmse",
        "AIC",
        "BIC"
    ),
    # Add interaction and fixed effect indicators
    add_rows = additional_rows,

    notes = c(
        "Dependent variable: standardized log(Price).",
        "Continuous variables are z-scored (mean 0, SD 1); coefficients are in SD units.",
        "HC3 robust standard errors in parentheses.",
        "Reference property type: Townhome."
    )
)

```
```{r}
modelplot(
  models,
  vcov = "HC3",
  conf_level = 0.95,
  coef_map = c(
    "log_Sqft_z"          = "Log(Square Footage)",
    "Bathrooms_z"         = "Bathrooms",
    "Bedrooms_z"          = "Bedrooms",
    "log_distance_park_z" = "Log(Distance to Park)",
    "log_distance_art_z"  = "Log(Distance to Public Art)"
  )
) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "Coefficient Estimates Across Models",
    subtitle = "Standardized variables, 95% robust confidence intervals",
    x = "Estimated Coefficient (SD units)", y = NULL,
    colour = "Regression Model"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

modelplot(
  list("Model 5: Without FE" = model5, "Model 6: With FE" = model6),
  vcov = "HC3",
  conf_level = 0.95,
  coef_map = c(
    "log_distance_park_z" = "Distance to Park (Log)",
    "log_distance_art_z"  = "Distance to Public Art (Log)"
  )
) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "Public Amenities and Housing Prices",
    subtitle = "Standardized effects, with and without neighbourhood fixed effects",
    x = "Estimated Effect (SD units)", y = NULL,
    colour = "Model"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```
```{r}
housing_2 <- housing |>
  mutate(pricepersqft = log(Price/Sqft))|>
  select(pricepersqft, log_Sqft, Type, neighbourhood, Bathrooms, Bedrooms, log_distance_park, log_distance_art) 
housing_2 <- housing_2|>
  mutate(Type = factor(Type), neighbourhood = factor(neighbourhood))

housing_2$Type <- relevel(housing_2$Type, ref = "Townhome")

model7 <- lm(pricepersqft ~ (log_Sqft + Bathrooms + Bedrooms)*Type +
               log_distance_park + log_distance_art + neighbourhood, data = housing_2)
model8 <- lm(pricepersqft ~ log_distance_park + log_distance_art + neighbourhood, data = housing_2)
model9 <- lm(pricepersqft ~ log_distance_park + log_distance_art, data = housing_2)
models2 <- list(
  "Model 7" = model7,
  "Model 8" = model8,
  "Model 9" = model9
)

additional_rows <- data.frame(
  term = c("Interaction Terms", "Neighbourhood FE"),
  "Model 7" = c("Yes", "Yes"),
  "Model 8" = c("No",  "Yes"),
  "Model 9" = c("No",  "No"),
  check.names = FALSE
)

modelsummary(
  models2,                                   # <- was `models`
  title = "Determinants of Housing Prices per Sqft in Vancouver",
  estimate = "{estimate}{stars}",
  statistic = "({std.error})",
  stars = c("*" = 0.10, "**" = 0.05, "***" = 0.01),
  fmt = 4,
  vcov = "HC3",
  coef_omit = "^neighbourhood",
  coef_rename = c(
    "log_Sqft"           = "Log(Square Footage)",
    "Bathrooms"          = "Bathrooms",
    "Bedrooms"           = "Bedrooms",
    "log_distance_park"  = "Log(Distance to Park)",
    "log_distance_art"   = "Log(Distance to Public Art)",
    "TypeCondo"          = "Condo",
    "TypeSingle Family"  = "Single Family"
  ),
  gof_map = c("nobs", "r.squared", "adj.r.squared", "rmse", "AIC", "BIC"),
  add_rows = additional_rows,
  notes = c(
    "Dependent variable: log(Price/Sqft).",
    "HC3 robust standard errors in parentheses.",
    "Reference property type: Townhome."
  )
)

```
```{r}
# Plot 1: amenity coefficients across the three models
modelplot(
  list("Model 7: Controls + interactions + FE" = model7,
       "Model 8: Amenities + FE"               = model8,
       "Model 9: Amenities only"               = model9),
  vcov = "HC3",
  conf_level = 0.95,
  coef_map = c(
    "log_distance_park" = "Log(Distance to Park)",
    "log_distance_art"  = "Log(Distance to Public Art)"
  )
) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title    = "Amenity Coefficients Across Models",
    subtitle = "Outcome: log price per sq ft; 95% robust confidence intervals",
    x = "Estimated Elasticity", y = NULL,
    colour = "Regression Model"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# Plot 2: with vs without neighbourhood fixed effects
modelplot(
  list("Model 9: Without FE" = model9, "Model 8: With FE" = model8),
  vcov = "HC3",
  conf_level = 0.95,
  coef_map = c(
    "log_distance_park" = "Distance to Park (Log)",
    "log_distance_art"  = "Distance to Public Art (Log)"
  )
) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title    = "Public Amenities and Housing Prices per Sq Ft",
    subtitle = "With and without neighbourhood fixed effects",
    x = "Estimated Elasticity", y = NULL,
    colour = "Model"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```
